scripts.typecheck: npm run generate && npm run cf-typegen && tsc --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.deploy: npm run generate && npm run cf-typegen && npm run typecheck && wrangler deploy
scripts.cards:seed:local: npm run cards:generate && wrangler d1 execute fairtravel-battle-db --local --file=generated/cards.sql
scripts.cards:seed:remote: npm run cards:generate && wrangler d1 execute fairtravel-battle-db --remote --file=generated/cards.sql
